summary: Tested Data → Information sub-sections (Entities/Teams/Federation) i18n in EN and FR for super admin juegolaureado@gmail.com on /auth → /dashboard. CRITICAL FINDING: language switch is NOT being applied at all. After clicking the visible [data-testid=language-selector-trigger] and then [data-testid=lang-option-en] (and lang-option-fr in a 2nd run), the top-right language badge still reads 'ES' and the ENTIRE top navigation (Datos/Scouting/Reporte/Sesiones/Diagnóstico/Información/Evaluación/Competencias/Periodización/Plan Gráfico/Herramientas) plus subtab labels (Entidades/Federación/Equipos/Atletas/Deportes/Torneos/Entrenadores) remain in Spanish. The user's premise that 'the menu/nav already translates' is NOT reproducible in this environment via the language-selector-trigger UI flow — meaning the test cannot validate the new sub-section translations because i18n.language never actually changes. Inside the Entities/Teams/Federation subsections, EVERY string is still in Spanish: 'Entidades' (h1), 'Federaciones, clubes, escuelas y organizaciones deportivas' (subtitle), 'Gestión de Entidades' (h2 wrapped in tt()), 'Nueva Entidad' (NOT wrapped), 'Federación / Selección Nacional / Liga / Torneo / Club Deportivo / Escuela Deportiva / Equipo / Grupo' (category labels); for Teams: 'Gestión de Equipos' (tt-wrapped), 'Nuevo Equipo' (NOT wrapped), 'Crea equipos, asigna deportes, entidades y gestiona sus atletas', 'Atletas'; for Federation: 'Panel de Federación' (tt-wrapped), 'Coordinación multi-club · multi-coach · multi-athlete' (subtitle), 'Clubes/Escuelas/Equipos/Atletas/Coaches/Planes Activos/Competencias/Evaluaciones 30d' (stat cards), 'Árbol Jerárquico', 'Comparativa de cumplimiento por club', 'Staff Asignado', 'Planes', 'Competencias', 'Sin staff asignado', 'Sin planes registrados', 'Sin competencias vinculadas', 'Asignar', 'Actualizar', 'Reporte Federación'. Same result in EN run and FR run — no translation happens. pageTranslator.js (global DOM translator) also does not appear to be acting (3.5s wait given, no text changed). Backend skipped per instructions.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking language-selector-trigger and then lang-option-en/-fr in the dashboard does NOT change i18n.language. The selector badge stays 'ES' and the whole nav (Datos/Scouting/Reporte/etc) remains in Spanish. This blocks ALL downstream i18n verification. Possible causes: (a) the visible trigger is a non-functional decorative element and the real one is hidden/in a different layer; (b) the dropdown portal renders the lang-option-X items but the onClick handler doesn't fire i18n.changeLanguage(); (c) localStorage.setItem('train_language', lang) is set but i18n is never re-initialized.

Unwrapped Spanish literals: line 161 'Nueva Entidad' button label and line 216 'Editar Entidad' / 'Nueva Entidad' dialog title are NOT wrapped in tt(). Even if language switched correctly, these would leak Spanish.
Unwrapped Spanish literals: line 168 'Nuevo Equipo' button and line 263 'Editar Equipo'/'Nuevo Equipo' dialog title NOT wrapped in tt().

Subtitle 'Federaciones, clubes, escuelas y organizaciones deportivas' and the 6 category labels (Federación / Selección Nacional / Liga / Torneo / Club Deportivo / Escuela Deportiva / Equipo / Grupo) appear unwrapped in tt() or not in info.lbl namespace — verify by inspecting EntityManager.js and adding tt() / locale keys.
'Crea equipos, asigna deportes, entidades y gestiona sus atletas' — present in es.json info.lbl but apparently rendered hardcoded in the component (not wrapped in tt()).

Stat-card labels (Clubes / Escuelas / Equipos / Atletas / Coaches / Planes Activos / Competencias / Evaluaciones 30d), section titles (Árbol Jerárquico, Comparativa de cumplimiento por club, Staff Asignado, Planes, Competencias), empty states (Sin staff asignado, Sin planes registrados, Sin competencias vinculadas), and actions (Asignar, Actualizar, Reporte Federación, Coordinación multi-club · multi-coach · multi-athlete) all render in Spanish — appear NOT wrapped in tt().

integration_issues.issue: Selecting EN/FR via the UI language selector trigger has no observable effect on rendered language. Until this is fixed, ALL i18n work in the subsections cannot be visually verified by users.

action_items: URGENT: Debug why clicking [data-testid=language-selector-trigger] + [data-testid=lang-option-en] does not change i18n.language. Verify the onClick on lang-option-* actually calls i18n.changeLanguage(lang) AND writes train_language to localStorage AND that the visible trigger in the dashboard top bar is the wired-up one (there are 2 triggers in the DOM per earlier reports — confirm the visible one in /dashboard has working handlers). Without this fix, the i18n work cannot be validated.

Wrap remaining Spanish literals with tt(): EntityManager.js:161 'Nueva Entidad', :216 'Editar Entidad'/'Nueva Entidad' dialog title; TeamManager.js:168 'Nuevo Equipo', :263 dialog title; FederationPanel.js stat-card labels and section titles & empty states (Clubes/Escuelas/Equipos/Atletas/Coaches/Planes Activos/Competencias/Evaluaciones 30d/Árbol Jerárquico/Comparativa de cumplimiento por club/Staff Asignado/Sin staff asignado/Sin planes registrados/Sin competencias vinculadas/Asignar/Actualizar/Reporte Federación/Coordinación multi-club · multi-coach · multi-athlete).

Verify pageTranslator.js is actually mounted in App.js and is observing/translating the dashboard DOM. Check console for any error / network calls to POST /api/i18n/translate (we saw none during the 3.5s waits). If it relies on MutationObserver, ensure it observes after subtab renders.

Confirm whether the 'Información' subtab list (Entidades/Federación/Equipos/Atletas/Deportes/Torneos/Entrenadores) labels live in the parent Dashboard.js — those should also be wrapped to translate; currently fully Spanish.
critical_code_review_comments: EntityManager.js, TeamManager.js, FederationPanel.js correctly import {tx as tt} and call useTranslation() for re-render, AND the main h2 titles ARE wrapped — BUT many sibling literals (subtitles, action buttons, dialog titles, stat labels, empty states) are NOT wrapped in tt(). The fix is mechanical: wrap each Spanish literal with {tt('...')}.

The CORE issue blocking validation is that the dashboard language selector UI does not change i18n.language. Even when localStorage 'train_language' was pre-set BEFORE login, the i18n init seems to ignore it on dashboard. Investigate i18n.js init order: lng should be read from localStorage.getItem('train_language') with fallback to 'es'.

pageTranslator.js (DOM-level fallback translator) did not produce any visible effect during 3.5s of post-render wait — neither did any /api/i18n/translate request fire (we'd see network activity). Confirm it is wired in App.js useEffect AND triggered after route/subtab changes.

User's stated premise ('the menu/nav already translates') could not be reproduced. Either it requires a different gesture (e.g., refresh after switch) or a different selector. Recommend the main agent reproduce on staging and inspect the LanguageSelector's onSelect handler.

success_rate.frontend: 0% — language switch does not propagate, so the new translations in info.lbl namespace (which DO exist for EN/FR — verified in /app/frontend/src/locales/en.json & fr.json) cannot be visually rendered. Plus ~10+ Spanish literals are not wrapped in tt() and would leak even if switching worked.

rca_of_the_issue: Hypothesis: the LanguageSelector component renders a dropdown of lang-option-* buttons but the onClick either (a) doesn't call i18n.changeLanguage at all, (b) writes to localStorage but the i18n instance was initialized with hardcoded 'es', or (c) two LanguageSelector instances exist (header + somewhere else) and only the non-visible one is functional. Repro: login at /auth → click [data-testid=language-selector-trigger] (visible one in dashboard top-right) → click [data-testid=lang-option-en] in popover → observe that the badge text remains 'ES' and all Datos/Scouting/Reporte nav labels stay in Spanish. Expected: badge shows 'EN' and nav switches to English (the user's stated baseline).
